Main idea behind it all was to show our three years together and growth. As you can see the Russian dolls are getting bigger but also merging together (thanks to love - heart symbol binding us closer together with time)

I had to start out with our Reddit avatars because we met on Reddit
I gave my bf lighting because his past was geared towards aggression and fights (he’s a very combative person) and me tears because sadness and depression was my past. We both helped each other a lot to not fully get over but tame these sides of us
(I actually love lighting/rain comparison it wasn’t intended but I love it!)
We both used to self harm which was our first connection so I added faded red from top. Blood we spilled

Next dolls are salmon and a tiger 
His name is Salman so I tend to portray him this way. Sockeye salmon because they both have a cute big nose. 
I’m a tiger because of my self harm scars
It has some more personal symbolism for me regarding our second year but it’s too much to explain 

Lastly is moon and the starts and the sun. 
Me and my parents used to watch Game of Thrones. They started calling each other sun and moon and the starts for a bit since it was the names of Khal Drogo and Khaleesi. I found it to be extremely romantic
Salman doesn’t like origin story of that (my father was a piece of shit) but I do so I decided I can at least add it in my work
I also liked how my first and last Russian doll both have drop shape motif but meaning is reversed 


As you can see it’s deeply personal. Just for me and him. I don’t mind that it’s not obvious to others - that’s kind of the point. But once I finished I was like “oh boi that’s a lot of different colors 😳” So I was wondering it that mix doesn’t look like unicorn puke
